scripts-descriptions.gates: Run the full quality gate chain exactly as CI does
scripts-descriptions.gate:proof: Prove the Deptrac gate actually rejects an illegal dependency
scripts-descriptions.preflight: Report what this deployment can and cannot do; --strict fails on anything production should not be missing
scripts-descriptions.restore:drill: Dump the database, restore it into a scratch copy, and verify the copy is the database that was dumped
scripts-descriptions.demo:seed: Seed a demonstration world into an empty database, and read it back to prove it holds
scripts-descriptions.demo:reset: The same, wiping the business tables first (reference data untouched)
scripts-descriptions.gate:products: Prove no code branches on product identity (§12.1)
scripts-descriptions.gate:plans: Prove no code branches on a plan or tier name (§13)
scripts-descriptions.gate:money: Prove no mutation that moves money writes to the cache before the server answers (U6)
scripts-descriptions.gate:roles: Prove docs/three-roles-end-to-end.md accounts for every operation, both ways
scripts-descriptions.gate:screens: Prove every screen area has a route and calls every operation it claims (U9) — the check ui-spec.md §7 could not make until a frontend existed
scripts-descriptions.gate:ci: Prove CI runs every gate in this chain — gate:screens was chained and never added to the workflow, so it ran in CI zero times
scripts-descriptions.dist: Build the deployable bundle (docs/deploying-to-siteground.md). Needs SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
scripts-descriptions.dist:verify: Serve the built bundle and check it over HTTP before a host does
